decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - AMEND AND REPLACE CONDITION 2 OF PARENT PERMISSION REF: 2024/02834/FUL TO READ:

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the approved plans and drawings listed in this decision notice, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission.

- Approved plans and drawings: 392-03 rev B; 392-04 rev B

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 2 - INCLUDE ADDITIONAL CONDITION 6 TO PARENT PERMISSION REF: 2024/02834/FUL TO READ:

The rooflights hereby approved shall not protrude more than 0.15m above the surface of the roof planes. 

To ensure a satisfactory appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1 and DC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Non-material amendments to planning permission reference: 2024/02834/FUL dated 4th February 2025 for the "Erection of an additional floor at roof level including the formation of a roof terrace at second floor level to the front elevation."  Amendments sought are alterations to the internal layout, installation of a velux rooflight in the rear mansard roof elevation, and formation of two rooflights in the flat roof of the mansard roof extension.
